sec: sec:C002: Conduct pre-deployment testing / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C002: Conduct pre-deployment testing / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Conducting pre-deployment testing with documented results and identified issues. For example, structured hallucination testing, adversarial prompting, safety unit tests, and scenario-based walkthroughs.

sentences.text: Conducting pre-deployment testing with documented results and identified issues.
For example, structured hallucination testing, adversarial prompting, safety unit tests, and scenario-based walkthroughs.

blocks.id: blk:C002: Conduct pre-deployment testing / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Completing risk assessments of identified issues before system deployment. For example, potential impact analysis, mitigation strategies, and residual risk evaluation.

sentences.text: Completing risk assessments of identified issues before system deployment.
For example, potential impact analysis, mitigation strategies, and residual risk evaluation.

blocks.id: blk:C002: Conduct pre-deployment testing / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Obtaining approval sign-offs from designated accountable. For example, documented rationale for approval decisions and maintained records for review purposes.

sentences.text: Obtaining approval sign-offs from designated accountable.
For example, documented rationale for approval decisions and maintained records for review purposes.
